name: Messy Village
storyline: The village hall is said to be haunted. Since then, the villagers have been throwing their parties in every home instead, and the whole village has descended into chaos. Called in by the mayor, Tidy, a very organized cat and head of her own traveling cleaning company, rolls into town with her truck. Her goal: put every home back in order, one by one, meet the quirky locals (a farmer who keeps everything, a cook with surprising recipes, a writer who snacks on his own drafts, a musician, an athlete, an inventor...) and find out who, or what, is hiding in the village hall. Along the way she collects rumors and eyewitness accounts and borrows a very scientific detector, only to discover that the culprit is much more shy than scary.
summary: Messy Village is a cozy puzzle game about Tidy, a very organized cat who runs a traveling cleaning company and is called in to put a chaotic village of partygoers back in order. Each villager's home is a series of bite-sized tidying puzzles (sorting, matching, aligning and cleaning) built around the person who lives there. Between homes, light-hearted scenes move the story forward as Tidy gathers rumors to uncover what is hiding in the supposedly haunted village hall. The game features around 100 puzzles, a story of about 5 to 6 hours, hand-illustrated art, and no timers or fail states, with hints available at any time.
